user_text: Plan a 1-day migration from SVN to Git for a small repo.
assistant_text:
# 1-Day SVN → Git Migration Plan

## Prerequisites (Night Before)
- Install `git-svn` or `svn2git`
- Inventory the repo: branches, tags, size, externals
- Create author mapping file (`authors.txt`)

```
jsmith = John Smith <jsmith@company.com>
mjones = Mary Jones <mjones@company.com>
```

---

## Schedule

### Morning (2–3 hrs) — Clone & Convert
```bash
# Option A: git-svn
git svn clone https://svn.example.com/repo \
  --authors-file=authors.txt \
  --stdlayout \
  --no-metadata \
  -s myrepo

# Option B: svn2git (cleaner tags/branches)
svn2git https://svn.example.com/repo \
  --authors authors.txt \
  --stdlayout
```

**Verify:**
- Commit count matches SVN
- Branches and tags present
- History looks correct (`git log --oneline`)

---

### Midday (1–2 hrs) — Clean Up
```bash
# Convert svn:externals → git submodules (if needed)
# Remove large/unwanted files
git filter-repo --path secrets/ --invert-paths

# Verify .gitignore (convert svn:ignore)
git svn show-ignore > .gitignore
git add .gitignore && git commit -m "Add .gitignore"
```

---

### Early Afternoon (1 hr) — Push to Remote
```bash
# Add remote (GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket)
git remote add origin git@github.com:org/myrepo.git

# Push all branches and tags
git push -u origin --all
git push origin --tags
```

---

### Late Afternoon (1–2 hrs) — Team Cutover
| Task | Action |
|------|--------|
| Lock SVN repo | Set to read-only |
| Notify team | Send Git clone URL + cheat sheet |
| Update CI/CD | Point pipelines to new Git remote |
| Update docs | README, wikis, ticket links |
| Test a PR/MR | Validate workflow end-to-end |

---

### End of Day — Validate & Close Out
- [ ] All team members can clone successfully
- [ ] CI/CD pipeline passes
- [ ] SVN marked read-only with redirect notice
- [ ] Old SVN URL documented for reference

---

## Key Risks & Mitigations
| Risk | Mitigation |
|------|------------|
| Missing authors | Pre-build complete `authors.txt` |
| SVN externals | Convert to submodules or vendor manually |
| Large binary files | Use Git LFS before pushing |
| Long history/large repo | Run clone overnight if needed |

Based on the migration plan above:

1. **SVN Externals** — Can break builds if not converted to submodules or vendored before cutover
2. **Incomplete Author Mapping** — Missing entries halt the conversion mid-run; requires a complete `authors.txt` upfront
3. **Large Binary Files** — Bloat repo size and slow clones; need Git LFS configured *before* pushing to remote

## Migration Checklist

- [ ] Build complete `authors.txt`
- [ ] Audit repo for externals and binaries
- [ ] Configure Git LFS if needed
- [ ] Run and verify conversion locally
- [ ] Lock SVN repo (read-only)
- [ ] Push to remote (branches + tags)
- [ ] Update CI/CD pipelines
- [ ] Confirm all team members can clone
Keep SVN read-only (not deleted) for 1–2 weeks so the team can revert to it if Git adoption fails.
A complete `authors.txt` mapping every SVN username to a Git name and email.
